name: center
description: Centers a column of content horizontally, up to a maximum width, with gutters on narrow screens.

attributes.name: data-max
attributes.description: The widest the content column may be.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: The gutter on each side when the container is narrower than the maximum.

attributes.name: data-intrinsic
attributes.description: Shrink the column to its content (still no wider than data-max) and center it, with each child centered on its own width inside it.
